```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Tag Create</title>
    @livewireStyles
    <style>
        .form-group {
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100 font-sans leading-normal antialiased text-gray-800">
    <div class="container px-4 mx-auto">
        <div class="py-6 rounded-lg shadow-md bg-white mt-8">
            <h2 class="text-xl font-bold mb-6">Create a Tag</h2>
            <form wire:submit.prevent="storeTag">
                <div class="form-group">
                    <label for="name" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">Name</label>
                    <input type="text" wire:model="name" id="name" class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500">
                </div>
                <button type="submit" class="bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg shadow-md mt-6">Create Tag</button>
            </form>
        </div>
    </div>

    @livewireScripts
</body>
</html>
```

This code snippet creates a basic Livewire blade view for the 'TagCreateComponent' component, using Tailwind CSS for styling and Alpine.js for interactivity. It includes fields for the tag name, a submit button, and basic form validation using Laravel's Blade directives.
